lines: Spinning and spinning, our feelings
My heart is tangled and sinking in a swamp, and it's all your fault, you know?
Words like "love" or "like" aren't enough to say it
Floating all over you, my love-struck brain
My love is critically ill and painful, remission is difficult too
The address of my heart is blank, it's always like this every time
Stop! Is this a trap? Our eyes met!
With just a little motion, to the affection you show
Somehow, please turn around
It cannot be expressed in one, two, three
The weight of this feeling is just how it is (Oh yeah!)
I know the words I should spit out, but
I can't say them (I won't say them)
I still want to keep things vague
Spinning and spinning, our feelings
My heart is tangled and sinking in a swamp, and it's all your fault, you know?
"Just right" or "moderate" is still not enough!
I want to stay unstable over you, I love-brain you
Wait, this is still (Love, no!)
No matter what I say, look (Love-struck brain!)
Because on the surface, it's still (Love, no!)
But actually, it's a severe case of (Love-struck brain!)
Even if I make my heart vague, it's a hard doubling game
Every day, these feelings keep piling up, hey, can you picture this yearning?
If I say something like that, the answer sheet is fully visible
Because it's a perfect score
I absolutely won't allow that
I won't let only you stay cool!
I'm not, I'm not blushing at all
If you noticed, then you're immediately mine, mine
I want to monopolize you, I want to be alone with you

Saying that it's a lie is also a lie
What should I do?

But actually, I know the truth
So much that even "you and me" is uncertain
I want to melt the boundary with you (Oh yeah!)

Spinning in vain, my feelings
Even now, my heart is sinking in a swamp, it hurts quite a bit but
I want to push my support even to your bad parts
My brain won't stop with you, you worry me?
Show me you can cross it, our secret

I want to stay unstable over you, I love-brain you
